config.autoclutch.title: AutoClutch Config
config.autoclutch.enabled.description: Toggle the mod on/off. When disabled, water bucket clutching will not be automated.
config.autoclutch.group.timing.descripti: Configure when the water bucket is placed during a fall. Higher mean = earlier placement, higher variance = more variation in timing.
config.autoclutch.mean.description: Average distance above ground when water is placed. Range: 1.5-4.5 blocks. Recommended: 2.5 blocks for skilled play.
config.autoclutch.variance.description: How much the timing varies (standard deviation). Higher = more human-like variation. Range: 0.5-2.5 blocks. Recommended: 1.2 blocks.
